text: Power only pays when it crosses a bracket line: near 2.2G each +0.2G moves the 35% reach about three to four chapters, and 328-30 at 35% needs 4.00G.
detail: From record 003's stage table: 2.2G reaches 55% to 288-3 and 35% to 304-19; 2.4G 291-19 / 308-5; 3.0G 300-22 / 317-8; 4.0G 312-14 / 328-29. Moving from the 55% to the 75% bracket is +36% real damage for the same raw damage.

text: Stellar Link gives the largest posted steps late: opening constellation 8 and its third point were worth +13% and +10%.
detail: 1.5G → 1.7G for opening constellation 8; 2G → 2.2G for completing its 3-point triangle. Points open with total cookie stars (pets don't count): free pulls reach 8-3, and 8-3 → 8-6 is about 45 stars from paid pulls. Stellar Points only reshape open points: ~1,900 expected for the 91% octagon, ~5,000–8,000 for 95% at 10 points, 150,000+ for 100%. Later constellations give more per % of area, so free players stop early ones at ~70%.

text: The guild is free to check but unmeasured: the only figure is one reply's ~+20% of account total power for a research-13 guild.
detail: The reply speaks of 총투력 (account total), not team power, so no stage reach is derived from it. A separate post fell to the 15% cut after leaving a guild. Guild help also shortens Gnome Lab timers.

text: Plating is steady but slow: to 15 costs about 414 Chocosteel and 43 Syrup per slot, and past 15 each step is a 2–12% roll with shatter risk.
detail: One poster at '1G 600M' put a level at about +8M and 14→15 at +20–30M. Free Chocosteel is 24 a day; Syrup comes from exchanges and the ₩9,900 plating pack (70 + 30), and about 1.5 packs cover one expected 14→15 step (inferred). Since 1.4.002 a shatter drops 2 levels and can be restored with 20–80 Syrup; the cap is 25. Most posted 4G accounts have weapon plates at 19–21; one reached 4G with none above 18.

text: Resolve and cookie levels are early-game power; late they barely move the number.
detail: Early a Resolve level was worth ~1,000 power and a new player more than doubled with Resolve, Stellar and gear. Late, +200 Resolve levels raised Milk's ATK ~1k where one gear line raised it 6k; levels 91–100 cost 77% of the EXP to 100. Bank coin chests and open them when a 35% line fails.

text: The free order at 2.2G is the community's: check the guild and pad a stage preset (both unmeasured, both free), open Stellar points up to 8-3 (posted), then the lab, weapon plating, oven levels, Fame and banked Resolve.
detail: The 2G → 4G player credits oven 36, research, Bari 5★ and Stellar 8-6; a 4G account shows sword 20, bow 19, Resolve 997, Fame 130, lab HP 30%.

text: The paid order is the community's, with no posted power figure for any package: Ad Removal and the Unique gear pack, the Crumble Pass, the 5.5 permanent membership, weekly dungeon keys; TSSR stars last.
detail: Ad Removal and Crumble Pass are $4.99 (₩7,500) each, the weekly key set $3.99 (₩6,000). Stellar Link Pack Vol.1 is ₩32,000 for 12,000 Stellar Points (it shapes open points). A pickup TSSR costs ~₩289,000 to 5★ and ~₩972,000 to 10★; a blessing-7 player at 3G+ said 328 would take another ~₩3,000,000. Stellar points and plating can't be compared per won from the evidence.

text: Displayed power is not strength: it weights attack-type cookies and the stats you lack, so pad it for stages and ignore it elsewhere.
detail: Swapping a support for an attacker raises team power; an item's power falls once a resistance target is met; accuracy past ~1,000 adds little. Arena and Guild Conquest ignore the number.
